Introduction

This
document details the testing procedures P1, required to completely check the 
proper operation and calibration of the relay, to be carried out on every six 
months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

This
petition concerns the list of protection relays of 400 VCB, manufactured by
(SKODA).
The CB is of type either ARV or J2UXT of rating 630 A.

This document
initiated by eng. Maysa Ahmady, tested by eng. Iman Rizk EL-Ashry, reviewed by quality control engineer eng.
Adel Abd El-Kader EL-Nagar of EDEPC, approved by eng. Awad Fathy Soliman: 
Talkha PS head sector, 
and certified by eng. Aly 
 Mostafa Al-Lethy; EDEPC inspection & quality control head sector.

Connect the tester with a 220 Vac source.

Dismantle the CB socket ( on the left )
and all pins of CB.

Connect cable (2) between the tester and
the CB. socket ( left one ).

Screw out all the pins of the blocks
except the pin of (K) it is better to put it on the lowest value .

Press the tester push button to test the
(Pn) block . The green light indicates good resistors.

If you test
the Pn with no pin screwed in (k) then the test isnt achieved and a sign Pnn
will appear on screen. During further tests this pin must be always screwed out

Press the push buttons to test the diodes
(Pnd). The green lamp indicates good diodes.

Press the push buttons to transfer to STA
test in which an inner stabilized feeding voltage to the relay is measured the
value of the voltage should be 6.2-7.6V

A value of the voltage of CB will
display on the screen.
